description: Settings for receipts of human-approved wording changes to restored articles. Each receipt is its own file in migration/accepted-edits/, named <slug>.pr-<number>.json: the exact file it was based on, the accepted file, the replaced text, and who approved it. The fidelity check rebuilds the preserved original from these receipts. A receipt needs required_approvals approvals from the reviewers below, other than the author; the receipts check takes the reviewers from the pull request's base. See CONTRIBUTING.md (Accepted editorial changes).
